name: Edelbar
title: Edelbar
summary: Edelbar was an old Aluvian settlement west of Holtburg, attacked by Tumeroks before Portal Year 10 ('Here's where my friend Galtith died helping the townsfolk escape' - Alatar Locke) and now home to banderlings, drudges and rats. In the kit: a Life Stone on a fern-covered hilltop (z 94) with a 5.5 m ancient column, a diagonal row of broken Empyrean pillar stubs and seals running 120 m down the slope to the south-east toward a mossy candle sentinel (acpedia's 'Empyrean Statue gazing towards the lifestone, a row of Empyrean Pillars between the two'), and abandoned cottages and barns 140-230 m to the south and east.

shots.standingOrder: Dolly slowly in on Edelbar's Life Stone from the west, its sparkle backlit by the low morning sun with the ancient column and the broken pillar row beyond; keep 1.5 m from every rock and fern.
shots.notes: Signature view of the ruined village: slow linear dolly from 9.6 m to 4.4 m on Edelbar's hilltop Life Stone from the west, 2 m above the ferns, its sparkle backlit by the low ESE morning sun (0.39) with the 5.5 m ancient column and the diagonal line of broken Empyrean pillar stubs and seals running down the slope beyond toward the candle sentinel. vmax 0.9 m/s, so the 1.2 m slow-classic clearance applies (nearest fern 1.5 m).
